cs.t:
Disclaimer: I have a Mini XL+, but it's primarily storage on my office 10gbe network. Intel(R) Atom(TM) CPU C3758 @ 2.20GHz
127.9GiB ECC RAM
8x WD in raidz2
1 SSD slot is a time machine pool for backing up my laptop on the network. Scale would provide far more home server options than core. But all in all, the community is awesome, you're somewhat supporting open source and ZFS. And the big one for me is I can repair it, or swap out ALL the hardware if I want to upgrade.
